fields.inputType: Where the data lives: "file", "database", "lakehouse", "databricks" or "inline". Each type has its own required keys.
fields.mode: "scan" reads lazily (Parquet, CSV, NDJSON, IPC); "read" loads eagerly for formats that cannot scan.
fields.path: The file's path relative to the project root, with forward slashes.
fields.arguments: Options passed to the Polars reader for the format, such as {"try_parse_dates": true} for CSV. Leave {} when none are needed.
fields.steps: Optional post-processing of the loaded frame as step cards; df is already the loaded frame, so there is no source step. Keep [] when the file is used as read.
